gemini-2.5-flash.standardized_narrative: Syndicate 1183 reported a net release of $57.8 million in its prior year claims provisions for 2022. This release was primarily driven by favorable claims development across most lines of business, with specific mention of decreased uncertainty related to COVID-19 pandemic claims. However, there was a strengthening in the Specialty line of business. Overall, the syndicate's 2022 performance was impacted by higher catastrophe losses (including Hurricane Ian and the Russia-Ukraine conflict) and reserve strengthening for economic inflation, partially offset by favorable current year attritional and large losses.
